mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interactions between rising employment (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 5%) create a virtuous cycle, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher when both conditions are met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals reduced supply chain pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: Positive GDP growth (GDPC1) is a persistent driver of positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between rising CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) creates an inflation-adjusted rate environment conducive to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment (UNRATE > 0.5% in 1 month) signals impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE increases sharply.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: In a monetary tightening cycle, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below its 3-month moving average amplifies the negative impact on S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window during tightening cycles.
